items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: And in my opinion he listened to all the modern cats and then he brought in this — actually I was playing saxophone with it

ctx.x: Speaking of getting it, I see on your quote resume, that when you were still on the West Coast you did some work with Frank Zappa. Is that correct?

Yes. The Berkley, California Symphony commissioned him. This is a great story. They commissioned him to write a symphony or whatever. And in my opinion he listened to all the modern cats and then he brought in this — actually I was playing saxophone with it, and I had never — excuse me — played with a symphony orchestra. So I got the music ahead and I’m practicing and it’s like all this multi-polyrhythmic stuff. Like it would be in 3/4 it would be four over three and then within that there would be some triplets,…
Oh you are correct, it makes for a great story. Gee I wonder how soon they booked Frank back?
